items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: They know the young guys. They get together. And they decide what they're going to do.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I suppose you had a first base when you said, well you guys play baseball. You're well played my way. But what happened to the team? It's the same thing to me.

Now you know something? I went to a rock person. Young guys. And I heard about the jazz festival when I was talking to them. I was talking to them about recording them. I went to their voices. They know the young guys. They get together. And they decide what they're going to do. And if a guy comes up with an idea, they do it. But the average jazz musician, you want to do life corporate music.
Do you think that's new or old? Do you think the old guys used to do that or not?
